Adulthood
With the advent of adulthood, the adolescent 
passes through the portals of what may be 
termed as the "real world". One enters the world 
of higher education, work, and marriage, and 
gets involved in establishing one's own family. 
Hence responsibilities of the individual increase 
manifold. In this unit you will learn about the 
major factors that play a role in determining

Planning, controlling and evaluating the use of all these types of incomes is called financial management.

The quality of living that can be exchanged for financial resources is dependent not only on how much income is available, but more importantly on the regularity and stability of income.
